title: Finish before starting more
hook: Three started tasks are not three finished tasks.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Compare serial completion to round-robin partial progress.

objective: Compare serial completion to round-robin partial progress.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: Three started tasks are not three finished tasks. Same three jobs, same order A, B, C. Which plan finishes its first job sooner? Correct option: Whole jobs, one at a time. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
claims.source: Explicit exercise fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts and pure rules in studyModels.ts. All times, sizes, deadlines and outcomes describe this exercise only; no empirical productivity or learning effect is inferred. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md. W-403 (2026-10-14, demo-builder): Re-worded after FC LH-4 (company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH4-2026-10-14.md): both views now use the one order A (10 min), B (15 min), C (5 min). Whole jobs first completion 10 (queueResult, ends 10, 25, 30); 5-minute turns first completion 15 (roundRobinQueue, ends A 20, B 30, C 15). Options are "Whole jobs, one at a time" / "Rotate 5-minute turns". Awaiting fact-checker re-check.

claims.text: Same order A, B, C and the same 30 minutes of work. Run whole, A is done at minute 10. In 5-minute turns the first job done is C, at minute 15, and A waits until minute 20. Starting and finishing are different counts.
claims.source: Explicit exercise fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts (study_work_in_process_limit: durations C=5, A=10, B=15; order A, B, C in both views, initial = target = [1,2,0]) and pure rules in studyModels.ts. All times, sizes, deadlines and outcomes describe this exercise only; no empirical productivity or learning effect is inferred. W-403 (2026-10-14, demo-builder): Fix for the FC LH-4 dispute (company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH4-2026-10-14.md: the old 5 → 15 change came from job order, not slicing). The stage now compares ONE order. "Run queue" shows 5-minute turns in order A, B, C: A 0–5, B 5–10, C 10–15 (C done 15), A 15–20 (A done 20), B 20–30 (B done 30); first completion 15 (roundRobinQueue). "Whole jobs" keeps the order: A 0–10, B 10–25, C 25–30; first completion 10 (queueResult). Total 5+10+15 = 30 both ways. The first job in line (A, 10 min) is longer than one 5-minute turn, so slicing really delays it (10 → 20). Recall (three 10-minute tasks: 10 one by one, 20 rotating) applies the same rule. Earlier history: W-367 fixed the FC LH-1 dispute with the sentence FC LH-4 then disputed. Awaiting fact-checker re-check.

claims.text: Every displayed result is computed from the visible exercise state: order and view (whole jobs or 5-minute turns). Exercise only; no measured productivity gain. The reveal reports this same state and never translates its score into a personal productivity or memory benefit.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/studyModels.ts and src/components/lifehacks/StudyLesson.tsx, work-in-process-limit fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts. Stage rules: cumulative execution with stated setup cost; waiting is sum of start times; late means finish>due; dependency breach means predecessor is later in order. For the initial schedule, every unfinished task receives one five-minute slice per round; displayed rectangles are actual execution slices. First completion is min of completion times. The alternate schedule runs whole jobs serially in the same order; "Whole jobs" and "5-min turns" toggle only the view, never the order. No switching overhead or empirical efficiency is assumed. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md. W-403 (2026-10-14, demo-builder): text now names the view as state; controls changed (Swap first / Try target replaced by Whole jobs / 5-min turns for this lesson). Awaiting fact-checker re-check.

claims.text: Rotating, the first task gets its second 5 minutes at 15–20, so it completes at 20, not 10.

recall.question: Three 10-minute tasks. You either finish them one by one, or rotate 5 minutes on each. When is the first task done in each plan?
options: Minute 10 one by one; minute 20 rotating
Minute 10 one by one; minute 10 rotating
Minute 10 one by one; minute 5 rotating
recall.why: Rotating, the first task gets its second 5 minutes at 15–20, so it completes at 20, not 10.
